error.auth.plain: Paste your API key (it starts with mm_sk_). Lost it? Run {fix} to make a new one.

error.auth_bad.plain: That key didn't work. Check you copied all of it, or make a new one with {fix}.

error.server_down.plain: The API isn't answering. Start it with {fix} and reload this page.

error.rate_limit.plain: Too many requests. Give it {n}s and try again.

error.crash.plain: Something went wrong on the server: {detail}

error.missing.plain: That page doesn't exist (any more). Head back to your brains.

query.empty.plain: Nothing in your library matches that. Feed your brains a note on it and ask again.

query.thinking.plain: Finding the most relevant pieces of your library.

peek.intro.plain: Type a question. You'll see exactly which pieces of your library would be sent, and how small that is next to the whole thing. No AI is called.

peek.result.plain: {sent} tokens sent out of a {total}-token library ({share}).

peek.result_big.plain: {sent} tokens sent out of a {total}-token library ({share}). The share shrinks as you feed your brains more.

library.empty.plain: Your brains haven't been fed yet. Add some notes with {fix}, or try the sample library in examples/sample-notes, then come back.

library.welcome.plain: Each card is a domain of your library. Pick one, or search everything.

search.none.plain: No page titles or tags match "{q}". Try fewer words, or Peek to search inside pages.

fresh.stale.plain: Updated {age}, past its {threshold}-day freshness window. Re-feed the source.
fresh.stale.label: Stale

fresh.stale_brain.plain: {n} page(s) in {brain} are past their freshness window. Re-run the connector that feeds them.

fresh.all_good.plain: Nothing is past its freshness window.

easter.banana.plain: You found the banana. That's it. That's the feature.

error.credit.plain: Out of API credit. Top up your balance to continue.

error.network.plain: No network connection. Check your internet and retry.

wizard.welcome.plain: Welcome to Monkey Mind. Let's set up your brains.

wizard.name_brain.plain: Name this brain (e.g. Personal, Business, Health):

wizard.first_feed.plain: Add your first note to this brain:

wizard.done.plain: Setup complete. You can start asking questions now.

idea.graduate.plain: Promoting idea from 3am Brain to a tracked idea.

wizard.connect_senses.plain: Choose an AI tool to connect: ChatGPT, Claude Desktop or Claude Code.

moods.intro.plain: How fed each brain is: page counts, freshness and the feeding log.
